product_purpose: From localized Home, perform exactly one currently available zero-cost Bioenhancer Free Research 1x action, prove its cooldown successor, and return to positively recognized Home.

state_transitions.via: bounded Home pan and current-frame Research Lab binding
state_transitions.notes: At most six measured-progress pans are permitted before the route fails closed.
The Research radial successor must be positively recognized.
The Free Research 1x control must be freshly bound.

state_transitions.via: exactly one zero-cost Free Research 1x tap
state_transitions.notes: Completion requires a visible Free cooldown timer; count text alone is insufficient.

state_transitions.via: at most two bounded Android Back actions
state_transitions.notes: Completion remains blocked until native Home is positively recognized.

permitted_inputs: exactly one zero-cost Free Research 1x tap
at most two bounded Android Back actions
local_postconditions: exactly one free research transport call

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Only the freshly bound Free Research 1x control is permitted.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: A visible cooldown or absent free control permits no research dispatch and remains blocked until a later eligible observation.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Unknown results fail closed. Recovery performs no research action; at most two bounded Back actions may be used to prove Home.
evidence_requirements: fresh native 800x1280 source and immediate-before frames
current-frame Research Lab, radial, and Free Research bindings

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: Focused tests prove bounds and postcondition policy but do not substitute for retained native evidence.

live_validation_scenarios.notes: The checked-in pnsctl adapter owns the bounded development session; production registration and scheduling remain disabled.
